name: io.github.DwytMCL/anysite-mcp
title: anysite
description: Any website as MCP tools: a real Chrome signed in as you, and shortcuts the agent saves as tools.

environmentVariables.name: ANYSITE_HEADLESS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to run Chrome without a window (sign-in still opens one)

environmentVariables.name: ANYSITE_CHROME
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Chrome or Chromium binary

environmentVariables.name: ANYSITE_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Where profiles, saved shortcuts and settings.json live (default ~/.anysite-mcp)

environmentVariables.name: ANYSITE_CHROME_ARGS
environmentVariables.description: Extra Chrome flags, e.g. --no-sandbox when running as root in a container

environmentVariables.name: ANYSITE_DOWNLOADS
environmentVariables.description: Folder for files saved by web_download (default ~/Downloads/anysite)

environmentVariables.name: ANYSITE_LIBRARY
environmentVariables.description: A folder or URL to read the shortcuts library from instead of the public one
